Appendix: Artifact Description/Artifact Evaluation
Artifact Description (AD)
A Overview of Contributions and Artifacts
A.1 Paper’s Main Contributions
C1 An application-level approach calls MPI_Allgather to ob-
tain all metadata on all processes in order to generate a con-
sistent copy before calling the library’s data object creation
APIs.
C2 A library-level approach that allows independent creation of
unique data objects and checks the consistency of metadata
inside the I/O library.
C3 A new file header format that enables multiple MPI pro-
cesses to create data objects independently and write meta-
data to the file header in parallel.
A.2 Computational Artifacts
A1 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17089784
